description: This source file appears to be part of a web server or application server environment, managing environment variables and their duplication for HTTP requests, particularly for CGI/SCGI protocols. It defines functions for initializing, resetting, setting, getting, copying, and freeing environment data and integrating request details into environment variables.

methods.name: void _hash_free_gstring(gpointer data)
methods.description: A helper callback to free GString data stored in hash tables.

methods.name: void li_environment_init(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Initializes the environment structure by creating a new hash table with custom free functions.

methods.name: void li_environment_reset(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Removes all entries from the environment hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_clear(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Destroys the environment hash table and nullifies the pointer.

methods.name: void li_environment_set(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Creates new key and value strings and inserts them into the environment hash table.

methods.name: void li_environment_insert(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the environment hash, creating new strings if needed.

methods.name: void li_environment_remove(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the environment hash table using a fake constant GString for the key.

methods.name: GString * li_environment_get(liEnvironment * env,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment hash table using a fake constant GString for the key.

methods.name: liEnvironmentDup * li_environment_make_dup(liEnvironment * env)
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the environment hash table for separate usage.

methods.name: void li_environment_dup_free(liEnvironmentDup * envdup)
methods.description: Frees the duplicated environment structure and its hash table.

methods.name: GString * li_environment_dup_pop(liEnvironmentDup * envdup,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Removes and returns a value associated with a key from the duplicate environment.

methods.name: void add_env_var(liEnvironmentDup * envdup,liAddEnvironmentCB callback,gpointer param,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: A static helper to add environment variables, either by popping from duplicate or by callback.

methods.name: void cgi_fix_header_name(GString * str)
methods.description: Sanitizes and capitalizes HTTP header names to conform to CGI environment variable standards.

methods.name: void li_environment_dup2cgi(liVRequest * vr,liEnvironmentDup * envdup,liAddEnvironmentCB callback,gpointer param)
methods.description: Converts environment data and request information into CGI environment variables, calling a callback for each variable.
